senses.gloss: m. (τριτημόριον, S.) triens, one third of an as, a coin and a weight (about three ounces).
units: Snh. VIII, 2 ט׳ בשר (Bab. ed. 70ᵃ ת׳; Ms. F. ט׳, in Gemarah טרדימר; Y. Mish. טרת׳, Gemarah 26ᵃ טרט׳) a triens (worth?) of meat. Ib. 70ᵃ (ת׳) ט׳ זה וכ׳ I do not know what this ṭarṭemar means, but judging from R. José doubling the standard for wine, it may be inferred that ṭ. is half a Manah; Y. l. c. ט׳ חצי ליטרא ṭ. is half a Litra. (V. Zuckerm. Talm. Münzen p. 8).
